scenario_checks.question: Partial shipment and return preserve remaining inventory
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT f.quantity,r.quantity,l.quantity-f.quantity+r.quantity FROM order_lines l JOIN fulfillments f ON f.line_id=l.id JOIN returns r ON r.line_id=l.id WHERE f.quantity<l.quantity

scenario_checks.question: Find over-fulfilled lines without repairing source quantities
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT f.id FROM fulfillments f JOIN order_lines l ON f.line_id=l.id WHERE f.quantity>l.quantity ORDER BY f.id

scenario_checks.question: Compare exact payment, invoice and refund amounts
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT p.id FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON p.invoice_id=i.id WHERE p.amount=i.amount AND p.currency=i.currency

scenario_checks.question: Return and refund use the original product price
scenario_checks.sql: SELECT r.id FROM refunds r JOIN returns x ON x.id=r.return_id JOIN order_lines l ON l.id=x.line_id JOIN products p ON p.id=l.product_id WHERE r.amount=x.quantity*p.unit_price
